subject_definitions
<Subject 1> is the person defined by the supplied character sheet in <Picture 1>. Use the sheet as the sole reference for the character, without redesign.

summary
[reference generation] A ten-second cinematic café portrait. Seated beside a bright window, <Subject 1> sets down a coffee cup, notices someone familiar outside, leans forward slightly, and greets them with a small smile and a restrained hand gesture.

retention_analysis
<Subject 1>: fully_preserved from <Picture 1> throughout the shot.
<Picture 1> defines the character only, not the first frame, pose, environment, or layout. Do not reproduce the sheet's panels, repeated views, background, or labels.

detailed_description
Photorealistic cinematic imagery with an airy, intimate mood, soft window daylight, warm wooden surfaces, and gently blurred street scenery. Use vertical 3:4 framing, natural perspective, and a waist-up seated medium shot throughout.

[Shot 1] One continuous ten-second shot filmed entirely from inside the café. <Subject 1> sits at a small wooden table beside a tall window, her body angled slightly toward the glass. Position the camera on the interior side of the table at her eye level, initially viewing her from a three-quarter angle. The window sits beside her rather than between her and the lens, keeping her face clear of glass reflections. Soft street reflections remain confined to the window background. Place the tabletop low in the composition so her upper body, forearms, and hands remain visible.

During the first two seconds, she holds one ceramic coffee cup just above its matching saucer with her right hand. She gently lowers it until its base rests securely on the saucer, then releases the handle. Her left hand rests naturally on the table. The cup remains stationary afterward, with no spilling or duplicate vessels. She looks down briefly with a calm, unhurried expression.

During the next two seconds, a movement beyond the window catches her attention. Her eyes lift toward a fixed off-screen point outside, followed by a small turn of her head. Recognition appears gradually: a subtle brightening of her gaze, a slight lift of her eyebrows, and the beginning of a smile. Do not show the person outside or create a second character.

Over the following three seconds, she leans forward slightly from her seated position without standing. Her smile becomes warmer as she maintains the same outside eyeline. She raises her now-free right hand to upper-chest height, palm angled toward the window, and gives one small, gentle greeting movement. Keep her hand beside her face without obscuring it; the gesture stays relaxed and anatomically natural.

During the final three seconds, she lowers her right hand back toward the tabletop and settles into a comfortable posture, retaining her soft smile and eye contact with the unseen person. Throughout the shot, the camera makes a slow lateral slide of approximately thirty centimeters along the interior table edge, gradually revealing a more frontal view without crossing the window or the outside eyeline. Maintain a consistent waist-up distance, comfortable headroom, stable facial focus, and continuous illumination. End with one second of quiet anticipation. No cuts, speech, dramatic surprise, extra people, sudden zooms, captions, or logos.

overall_soundscape
Soft café room tone, faint distant street ambience filtered through the closed window, and one delicate ceramic clink as the cup meets the saucer. Subtle movement sounds, with no intelligible speech.

N/A
